name: Nitrogen
description:
Nitrogen is a fast and lightweight wallpaper browser and desktop background setter for X11. Widely favored in lightweight desktop environments and window managers, it provides quick background configuration without desktop bloat.

Features:
- Fast thumbnail generation and image browsing across multiple wallpaper folders
- Multiple wallpaper layout modes including Zoom, Centered, Tiled, Scaled, and Fill
- Multi-monitor support with independent wallpaper assignment per display
- Automatic restoration of desktop backgrounds on window manager startup via command line
- Lightweight GTK interface consuming minimal system memory
